Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: AI agents are rapidly maturing, transitioning from experimental demos into full production environments. Open-source frameworks are hitting milestones as adoption triples, while startups increasingly rely on model-driven orchestration over hand-coded systems. Tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are moving into regulated enterprise workflows, supported by emerging observability standards for end to end decision tracing.
